idea-plugin.name: Freeze Triage Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Lists every UI freeze your IDE recorded, newest first, with what blocked the UI and where: file I/O, an external process, a network call, a runBlocking, a lock held by another thread, class loading, an index lookup and more. When the EDT waits for the read/write lock, it names the thread holding it and what that thread was doing.

For each freeze: copy a Markdown report ready for an issue (title in the form JetBrains uses for freeze tickets, duration, build, trimmed stacks), search YouTrack for tickets about the same method before filing a duplicate, open the thread dump, or show the folder. Freezes from other installed versions of the same IDE are listed too.

Covers freezes in the platform itself, not only those caused by plugins. When a user-installed plugin is in the blocking stack, it is named.

Reads the thread dumps the IDE already writes to its log folder, in a background task. Nothing is sent anywhere: the YouTrack search opens in your browser only when you click it. Free. No license nags, no telemetry.

action.description: List the UI freezes this IDE recorded, with what blocked the UI and where
